resources.string:
v1.3.9
- New fast-scroll thumb on the right edge of Storage, Recents and Trash: a slim bar you can drag to move quickly through long lists.
- While you drag it, a bubble shows where you are: the initial, the date or the size, depending on how the list is sorted.
- When many files start the same way (IMG_, PXL_, Screenshot_, 20261114-), the bubble shows the date written in the name, or the first part that changes, instead of always the same letter.
- Renaming no longer replaces another file that already has that name; a warning is shown instead.
- "Save as" keeps long file names complete (they were cut to 80 characters and lost their extension).
- Cancelling "Save as" when pasting no longer discards the pending copy or move.
- Folder shortcuts now open their folder even when the app is already open.
- Updates: the installer opens again when the download finishes; "Check for updates" now reports a failed check instead of saying you are up to date, and offers again a version you dismissed.
- Cancelled or failed copies no longer leave partial files behind.
- Deleting a single item or moving it to the trash now runs in the background with a progress dialog.
- Larger thumbnail cache in Trash.

v1.3.8
- Fix: in-app update auto-install now works correctly on Android 13+ (RECEIVER_EXPORTED flag added for DownloadManager broadcast receiver).

v1.3.7
- When saving a single shared file, a "Save as" dialog now lets you confirm or edit the destination filename before the file is written. The base name is pre-selected so you can type a new name immediately.
- When pasting a single file from the clipboard (copy or move), the same "Save as" dialog appears before the operation runs.
- Multiple-file operations are unaffected.

v1.3.6
- App no longer appears in "Open with…" for arbitrary file types; only shares and file-picker intents remain registered.
- Selection count label now shows the number of selected items above the action bar.
- "Select all" and "Select by day" buttons added to the Recent tab header.
- Selecting all in Recents now toggles: a second tap deselects everything (matching Storage tab behaviour); button shows a check icon when all are selected.
- Folder context menu now includes an "Add shortcut to home screen" option.
- Update dialog now offers three choices: Download APK, Remind me later, Dismiss update.
- APK update download now uses DownloadManager for a direct in-app download; the installer opens automatically on completion.

v1.3.5
- Recents now auto-discovers files created or downloaded by other apps (WhatsApp, camera, browser, Telegram, etc.) using a single MediaStore query — no hardcoded paths.
- Pull-to-refresh gesture in Recents forces an immediate MediaStore scan.
- Returning to Recents after 30+ seconds away also triggers a fresh scan automatically.
- Fixed thumbnail cache (was capped at 20 KB — less than one thumbnail); now uses 1/8 of available heap so thumbnails display correctly.
- Fixed a discovery loop that caused notifyDataSetChanged cycles and required multiple taps to open a file.
- Fixed pull-to-refresh on empty folders: the SwipeRefreshLayout was hidden (GONE) when the folder was empty, making the gesture impossible.

v1.3.4
- The app now appears in "Open with…" when opening files from other apps; the file is registered in Recents and the browser navigates to its parent folder.
- The app now appears as a file picker when other apps request an attachment or upload (messaging, email, cloud storage apps, etc.).
- Recents no longer auto-discovers or MediaStore-scans files in the background; only manually opened or pinned items appear.
- Re-opening a file already in Recents keeps its position stable; the access timestamp is updated without promoting it to the top.

v1.3.3
- System trash now detected via MediaStore query (same as Google Photos), fixing missing items in the Trash screen.
- Folder item counts now include both system trash and app trash items.
- Only pinned folders appear in Recents; non-pinned folders are no longer added automatically.
- Trash icon now visible in both Storage and Recents tabs.
- New update checker: shows a dialog once a day when a newer version is available on GitHub.

v1.3.2
- Critical fix: files now correctly move to the app trash instead of being deleted directly.
- Fixed multi-selection also deleting permanently instead of moving to trash.
- Multi-selection in Trash screen: long-press to select, tap to toggle when selection is active, batch Restore / Delete actions.
- Trash thumbnails now use the original filename to detect media type (images, video, audio).
- Visited folders now appear in Recents, sorted by last access just like files.

v1.3.1
- Trash screen redesigned: thumbnail previews for images, videos, audio, and APKs.
- Tap in Trash opens files with the preferred app (same as main browser).
- Long-press in Trash shows a bottom action bar (Restore / Info / Delete).
- Both app-trash and system-trash sections are always visible, with an empty placeholder when empty.
- Section headers show an info badge (theme-aware).
- Empty trash now covers both sections with a combined count confirmation.
- Info in Trash shows the original path and the auto-delete countdown.
- Folder item counts now exclude hidden files and label trashed items separately.
- Fixed image opening via MediaStore URI so gallery apps can swipe between siblings.
- Default apps dialog now scrolls so buttons are always visible with long lists.
- Delete confirmation button order changed to: Delete forever / Cancel / Move to trash.
- Switching to Storage now clears any active selection in Recents.

v1.3.0
- Recents redesigned with the same row style and long-press selection behavior as Storage.
- Recents selection actions were streamlined to Locate/Pin/Info (single selection) and Pin/Remove from recents (multi-selection).
- In Recents, Info is now hidden when selecting 2 or more items.
- In Recents, selected items can now be removed directly from recents for one or multiple selection.
- Locate from Recents now jumps to Storage and selects the target file automatically.
- Visual pin badge is shown directly on pinned recent items.
- Recents stay ordered by access date, with clear day separators (Today, Yesterday, and date groups).
- Clear recents now removes only non-pinned items and keeps pinned ones.
- Auto-discovery no longer repopulates old files after clearing recents.
- Delete confirmation was reordered (Cancel, Delete permanently, Move to trash) with destructive action highlighted.
- Open picker More apps now uses the same base filtering approach as add-extension app selection.
- Storage header was compacted: quick actions moved next to title and a Home button was added.
- Breadcrumb now uses full width with side margins and wraps to additional lines only when needed.
- Send from Storage now also supports folder selection and opens compatible apps from the chooser.
- Share text save now opens a name and type dialog before creating the file.
- Interactive swipe between Recents and Storage now follows the finger smoothly.
- Open picker label shortened to More apps for clearer actions.

v1.2.9
- App name localized by system language.
- Open picker improved (Show more apps flow).
- Info action available for single item, including folders.
- Rename hidden on multi-selection.
- Quick guide links and GitHub link added to Settings.

v1.2.8
- Smarter temporary playlist names.
- Share sheet import with Save here.
- Moved files are removed from Recents.

v1.2.7
- Open/default app UX refinements and selection bar adjustments.
